risks.risk: The TV may not be functional beyond the loading screen, or may have internal damage not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A video showing the TV turning on, displaying a clear image, and responding to remote control or input.

risks.risk: The TV may have dead pixels, screen burn-in, or other display defects not visible in the loading screen.
risks.proof: A video showing the TV displaying a full white screen, full black screen, and a test pattern.

risks.risk: The TV may have physical damage not visible in the photo, such as cracked casing, broken stand, or internal damage.
risks.proof: A 360-degree video or multiple close-up photos of the TV from all angles, including the back and stand.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential hidden damage

A video showing the TV turning on and displaying a clear image.
